ScrCoRatio.derived: DeepONet field error over the coarse solve's, all v2 samples (B1)

ScrVthreeCoRatio.derived: DeepONet field error over the coarse solve's, all v3 samples

VthreeOverVtwo.derived: DeepONet p16 held-out error on v3 over v2 (B1, all samples)

RidgeOverHgb.derived: map term of ridge over that of per-mode boosting, v2, p = 8 (l5_mapterm_v2)

HgbOverDon.derived: POD + boosting field error over DeepONet's, all v2 samples (B1)

FloorRatioVthree.derived: POD basis floor at p = 8, MOF-like over smooth design (PREREG_DD_V3 V1)

BarRatio.derived: DeepONet's held-out 95th-percentile bar, MOF-like over smooth design

LsixPct.derived: L6 separate-heads gain as a percentage of the joint arm's error

ShMin.derived: smallest map share of squared error at p >= 16, both models, both designs (V1 and A1)

LCHalfFactor.derived: error increase the v2 learning curve predicts for half the training materials, 2^beta

MtMapChangePct.derived: change of the map term (per-mode boosting) from p = 8 to p = 128, % of p = 8

LthreeBestKanDiff.derived: perceptron minus best KAN held-out error (both from audit_l3.py)

AnchorAspect.derived: anchor bed length divided by tube diameter

LCexpRatio.derived: conditions-axis learning-curve exponent over the materials-axis one

LthreeLrDecades.derived: decades between the Chebyshev and perceptron optimal learning rates

FloorDrop.derived: POD floor at p=8 divided by the floor at p=128

FNOxFloor.derived: the best FNO divided by the POD floor at p=128

ONetxFloor.derived: the best DeepONet found anywhere (the p=8 arm) divided by the POD floor at p=128

FNOgain.derived: the best DeepONet divided by the best FNO

NwidthExpErr.derived: the n-width (error) exponent: half the fitted energy exponent

NwidthHalving.derived: modes needed to halve the ERROR, 2^(1/|energy exponent / 2|)

LfiveCoefChangePct.derived: the coefficient-map error's change from p=8 to p=128, per cent

WarpHeadroomFixed.derived: the fixed frame divided by the oracle two-wave arm

AnchorTcutPct.derived: the share of the 95 % arrival-time EXCESS over experiment that the untruncated dispersion closure removes

AnchorNrmseCutPct.derived: the share of the anchor nRMSE the untruncated closure removes

LfiveFlatImproveMax.derived: the largest improvement from p=8 to p=128 the interval admits, per cent

LfiveFlatDegradeMax.derived: the largest degradation the interval admits, per cent

LsixNoiseDrop.derived: the legacy between-material sd divided by v2's

LsixLegacyBetweenOverBase.derived: the legacy between-material sd as a share of its base error

GapRange.derived: the outlet separation of the two waves, max divided by min

LCmaterialsForHalving.derived: materials needed to halve the error at the measured exponent

CostDataRatio.derived: training simulations at 192 materials divided by those at 12

CostGenCoreHours.derived: the training set's cost in core-hours: solves x worker-seconds

LtwoLegacyVsLonePct.derived: legacy L2: best configuration's gain over the best L1 arm, % of the latter

WarpPredImproveMax.derived: warp, predicted fronts: largest improvement the interval admits, % of fixed

WarpPredDegradeMax.derived: warp, predicted fronts: largest degradation the interval admits, % of fixed

LfiveVtwoFloorDrop.derived: v2 bottleneck: basis floor at p=8 over p=128

LfiveVtwoCoefChangePct.derived: v2 bottleneck: coefficient-map error change p=8 -> 128, % of p=8

LsixSlopeSpanMax.derived: L6: largest change across the tested Da range the slope interval admits

LsixSlopeVsEffect.derived: L6: that change as a multiple of the main effect

WmofBtddRatio.derived: Co2Cl2(BTDD) capacity over the largest sampled capacity

OperatorLever.derived: L5 encoding: POD + best pointwise regressor over the best FNO (referee M1)

CoarseBreakEven.derived: queries at which the surrogate (training sims at the largest size, query time on the coarse baseline's own solve base) costs as much as coarse solving (B-COARSE)

CoarseAccRatio.derived: surrogate held-out error over the matching coarse solve's error (B-COARSE)

LClargestPct.derived: the largest learning-curve size's held-out nRMSE, in per cent (abstract)

ONetLever.derived: L5 encoding: POD + best pointwise regressor over the best DeepONet (round-2 N6)

LfourbRefTwinFactor.derived: material-axis refinement: twin's held-out error after / before

LfourbMatGainPct.derived: L4b material axis: the best physics arm's error reduction, % of the twin's
